responsibility: Top-level makefile fragment that integrates the Objective-C front end into GCC’s build, bootstrap, install, clean, and test machinery. It defines how cc1obj is linked from the Objective-C-specific objects plus shared C front-end/backend objects, arranges the bootstrap checksum object for cc1obj, registers Objective-C language selection and warnings, and supplies the language-specific stage movement, tags, and check-objc targets used by the main GCC build system.
